strict_success_rule: A conversion requires a durable pre-existing identity in the named community plus a live free anonymous operation that independently consumes an exact Agent Guild endpoint or trust artifact and returns a substantive result. Listings, discovery probes, caller-supplied-only validation, framework-name wrappers, payment challenges, registrations, and schema-only checks do not qualify.
method: Current public catalogs, descriptors, cards, OpenAPI documents, source-controlled import configuration and published issue identity evidence were read in memory. Only read-only GET/HEAD discovery was used. No candidate operation was invoked.

x402_amount_normalization.invariant: Determine price from the selected acceptance entry using `amount` for x402 v2 or `maxAmountRequired` for x402 v1. Parse an explicitly present finite decimal integer value in atomic asset units; a route is free only when that normalized value equals exactly zero. Missing, null, malformed, negative or unparseable values are unknown/invalid, never free.
x402_amount_normalization.normalization_result: The zero/nonzero classification is version-invariant after field normalization; catalogs containing both x402 generations must not count only one field or coerce a missing field to zero.
x402_amount_normalization.application_in_this_sweep: PayAI's newest 1000 records contained 20 effective-zero records after v1/v2 normalization; none had URL, URI, website, fetch, passport, credential, trust or preflight semantics. Agentic Market/CDP matches were nonzero after the same normalization.
